31// make default 0 to match previous behavior
32const MARGINS_SIZE: u32 = 0;
33
34/**
35 * This object renders a Data Matrix code as a BitMatrix 2D array of greyscale values.
36 *
37 * @author dswitkin@google.com (Daniel Switkin)
38 * @author Guillaume Le Biller Added to zxing lib.
39 */
40#[derive(Default)]
41pub struct DataMatrixWriter;
42
43impl Writer for DataMatrixWriter {
44    fn encode(
45        &self,
46        contents: &str,
47        format: &crate::BarcodeFormat,
48        width: i32,
49        height: i32,
50    ) -> Result<crate::common::BitMatrix> {
51        self.encode_with_hints(contents, format, width, height, &EncodeHints::default())
52    }
53
54    fn encode_with_hints(
55        &self,
56        contents: &str,
57        format: &crate::BarcodeFormat,
58        width: i32,
59        height: i32,
60        hints: &EncodeHints,
61    ) -> Result<crate::common::BitMatrix> {
62        if contents.is_empty() {
63            return Err(Exceptions::illegal_argument_with("Found empty contents"));
64        }
65
66        if format != &BarcodeFormat::DATA_MATRIX {
67            return Err(Exceptions::illegal_argument_with(format!(
68                "Can only encode DATA_MATRIX, but got {format:?}"
69            )));
70        }
71
72        if width < 0 || height < 0 {
73            return Err(Exceptions::illegal_argument_with(format!(
74                "Requested dimensions can't be negative: {width}x{height}"
75            )));
76        }
77
78        // Try to get force shape & min / max size
79        let shape = &hints.DataMatrixShape.unwrap_or(SymbolShapeHint::FORCE_NONE);
80        let minSize = hints.MinSize;
81        let maxSize = hints.MaxSize;
82
83        //1. step: Data encodation
84        let encoded;
85
86        let hasCompactionHint = hints.DataMatrixCompact.unwrap_or(false);
87        if hasCompactionHint {
88            let hasGS1FormatHint = hints.Gs1Format.unwrap_or(false);
89
90            let mut charset: Option<CharacterSet> = None;
91            if let Some(cs_name) = &hints.CharacterSet {
92                charset = CharacterSet::get_character_set_by_name(cs_name);
93            }
94            encoded = minimal_encoder::encodeHighLevelWithDetails(
95                contents,
96                charset,
97                if hasGS1FormatHint {
98                    Some(0x1D as char)
99                } else {
100                    None
101                },
102                *shape,
103            )?;
104        } else {
105            let hasForceC40Hint = hints.ForceC40.unwrap_or(false);
106            encoded = high_level_encoder::encodeHighLevelWithDimensionForceC40(
107                contents,
108                *shape,
109                minSize,
110                maxSize,
111                hasForceC40Hint,
112            )?;
113        }
114
115        let symbol_lookup = SymbolInfoLookup::new();
116        let Some(symbolInfo) = symbol_lookup.lookup_with_codewords_shape_size_fail(
117            encoded.chars().count() as u32,
118            *shape,
119            &minSize,
120            &maxSize,
121            true,
122        )?
123        else {
124            return Err(Exceptions::not_found_with("symbol info is bad"));
125        };
126
127        //2. step: ECC generation
128        let codewords = error_correction::encodeECC200(&encoded, symbolInfo)?;
129
130        //3. step: Module placement in Matrix
131        let mut placement = DefaultPlacement::new(
132            codewords,
133            symbolInfo.getSymbolDataWidth()? as usize,
134            symbolInfo.getSymbolDataHeight()? as usize,
135        );
136        placement.place()?;
137
138        let margins = if let Some(margin) = &hints.Margin {
139            margin
140                .parse::<u32>()
141                .map_err(|e| Exceptions::parse_with(format!("could not parse {margin}: {e}")))?
142        } else {
143            MARGINS_SIZE
144        };
145
146        //4. step: low-level encoding
147        Self::encodeLowLevel(&placement, symbolInfo, width as u32, height as u32, margins)
148    }
149}
150
151impl DataMatrixWriter {
152    /**
153     * Encode the given symbol info to a bit matrix.
154     *
155     * @param placement  The DataMatrix placement.
156     * @param symbolInfo The symbol info to encode.
157     * @return The bit matrix generated.
158     */
159    fn encodeLowLevel(
160        placement: &DefaultPlacement,
161        symbolInfo: &SymbolInfo,
162        width: u32,
163        height: u32,
164        margins: u32,
165    ) -> Result<BitMatrix> {
166        let symbolWidth = symbolInfo.getSymbolDataWidth()?;
167        let symbolHeight = symbolInfo.getSymbolDataHeight()?;
168
169        let mut matrix =
170            ByteMatrix::new(symbolInfo.getSymbolWidth()?, symbolInfo.getSymbolHeight()?);
171
172        let mut matrixY = 0;
173
174        for y in 0..symbolHeight {
175            // for (int y = 0; y < symbolHeight; y++) {
176            // Fill the top edge with alternate 0 / 1
177            let mut matrixX;
178            if (y % symbolInfo.matrixHeight) == 0 {
179                matrixX = 0;
180                for x in 0..symbolInfo.getSymbolWidth()? {
181                    // for (int x = 0; x < symbolInfo.getSymbolWidth(); x++) {
182                    matrix.set_bool(matrixX, matrixY, (x % 2) == 0);
183                    matrixX += 1;
184                }
185                matrixY += 1;
186            }
187            matrixX = 0;
188            for x in 0..symbolWidth {
189                // for (int x = 0; x < symbolWidth; x++) {
190                // Fill the right edge with full 1
191                if (x % symbolInfo.matrixWidth) == 0 {
192                    matrix.set_bool(matrixX, matrixY, true);
193                    matrixX += 1;
194                }
195                matrix.set_bool(matrixX, matrixY, placement.getBit(x as usize, y as usize));
196                matrixX += 1;
197                // Fill the right edge with alternate 0 / 1
198                if (x % symbolInfo.matrixWidth) == symbolInfo.matrixWidth - 1 {
199                    matrix.set_bool(matrixX, matrixY, (y % 2) == 0);
200                    matrixX += 1;
201                }
202            }
203            matrixY += 1;
204            // Fill the bottom edge with full 1
205            if (y % symbolInfo.matrixHeight) == symbolInfo.matrixHeight - 1 {
206                matrixX = 0;
207                for _x in 0..symbolInfo.getSymbolWidth()? {
208                    // for (int x = 0; x < symbolInfo.getSymbolWidth(); x++) {
209                    matrix.set_bool(matrixX, matrixY, true);
210                    matrixX += 1;
211                }
212                matrixY += 1;
213            }
214        }
215
216        Self::convertByteMatrixToBitMatrix(&matrix, width, height, margins)
217    }
218
219    /**
220     * Convert the ByteMatrix to BitMatrix.
221     *
222     * @param reqHeight The requested height of the image (in pixels) with the Datamatrix code
223     * @param reqWidth The requested width of the image (in pixels) with the Datamatrix code
224     * @param matrix The input matrix.
225     * @return The output matrix.
226     */
227    fn convertByteMatrixToBitMatrix(
228        matrix: &ByteMatrix,
229        reqWidth: u32,
230        reqHeight: u32,
231        margins: u32,
232    ) -> Result<BitMatrix> {
233        let matrixWidth = matrix.getWidth();
234        let matrixHeight = matrix.getHeight();
235        let paddedWidth = matrixWidth + (margins * 2);
236        let paddedHeight = matrixHeight + (margins * 2);
237        let outputWidth = reqWidth.max(paddedWidth);
238        let outputHeight = reqHeight.max(paddedHeight);
239
240        let multiple = (outputWidth / paddedWidth).min(outputHeight / paddedHeight);
241
242        let mut leftPadding = (outputWidth - (matrixWidth * multiple)) / 2;
243        let mut topPadding = (outputHeight - (matrixHeight * multiple)) / 2;
244
245        let mut output;
246
247        // remove padding if requested width and height are too small
248        if reqHeight < matrixHeight || reqWidth < matrixWidth {
249            leftPadding = 0;
250            topPadding = 0;
251            output = BitMatrix::new(matrixWidth, matrixHeight)?;
252        } else {
253            output = BitMatrix::new(reqWidth, reqHeight)?;
254        }
255
256        output.clear();
257        let mut inputY = 0;
258        let mut outputY = topPadding;
259        while inputY < matrixHeight {
260            // for (int inputY = 0, outputY = topPadding; inputY < matrixHeight; inputY++, outputY += multiple) {
261            // Write the contents of this row of the bytematrix
262            let mut inputX = 0;
263            let mut outputX = leftPadding;
264            while inputX < matrixWidth {
265                // for (int inputX = 0, outputX = leftPadding; inputX < matrixWidth; inputX++, outputX += multiple) {
266                if matrix.get(inputX, inputY) == 1 {
267                    output.setRegion(outputX, outputY, multiple, multiple)?;
268                }
269
270                inputX += 1;
271                outputX += multiple
272            }
273            inputY += 1;
274            outputY += multiple
275        }
276
277        Ok(output)
278    }
279}

281#[cfg(test)]
282mod tests {
283
284    use crate::{
285        datamatrix::{encoder::SymbolShapeHint, DataMatrixWriter},
286        BarcodeFormat, EncodeHintValue, EncodeHints, Writer,
287    };
288
289    #[test]
290    fn testDataMatrixImageWriter() {
291        let hints = EncodeHints::default().with(EncodeHintValue::DataMatrixShape(
292            SymbolShapeHint::FORCE_SQUARE,
293        ));
294
295        let bigEnough = 64;
296        let writer = DataMatrixWriter {};
297        let matrix = writer
298            .encode_with_hints(
299                "Hello Google",
300                &BarcodeFormat::DATA_MATRIX,
301                bigEnough,
302                bigEnough,
303                &hints,
304            )
305            .expect("must encode");
306        assert!(bigEnough >= matrix.getWidth() as i32);
307        assert!(bigEnough >= matrix.getHeight() as i32);
308    }
309
310    #[test]
311    fn testDataMatrixWriter() {
312        let hints = EncodeHints::default().with(EncodeHintValue::DataMatrixShape(
313            SymbolShapeHint::FORCE_SQUARE,
314        ));
315
316        let bigEnough = 14;
317        let writer = DataMatrixWriter {};
318        let matrix = writer
319            .encode_with_hints(
320                "Hello Me",
321                &BarcodeFormat::DATA_MATRIX,
322                bigEnough,
323                bigEnough,
324                &hints,
325            )
326            .expect("must encode");
327        assert_eq!(bigEnough, matrix.getWidth() as i32);
328        assert_eq!(bigEnough, matrix.getHeight() as i32);
329    }
330
331    #[test]
332    fn testDataMatrixTooSmall() {
333        // The DataMatrix will not fit in this size, so the matrix should come back bigger
334        let tooSmall = 8;
335        let writer = DataMatrixWriter {};
336        let matrix = writer
337            .encode_with_hints(
338                "http://www.google.com/",
339                &BarcodeFormat::DATA_MATRIX,
340                tooSmall,
341                tooSmall,
342                &EncodeHints::default(),
343            )
344            .expect("must encode");
345
346        assert!(tooSmall < matrix.getWidth() as i32);
347        assert!(tooSmall < matrix.getHeight() as i32);
348    }
349}
